# AuraLink Digital Agency — Complete AI Knowledge Base (llms-full.txt)

> AuraLink Digital Agency is a full-service AI engineering and digital transformation agency headquartered in Andhra Pradesh, India. We build autonomous AI agents, full-stack software applications, responsive websites, and digital marketing workflows for startups, local businesses, and global enterprises.

## 1. Core Competencies & Deliverables
- **Autonomous AI Voice Agents**: Inbound & outbound AI phone call handlers that conduct sales calls, schedule appointments, handle customer queries, and sync with CRMs.
- **WhatsApp API Business Bots**: 24/7 automated messaging agents integrated with Meta WhatsApp Cloud API for lead capture, customer support, and automated follow-ups.
- **Custom Web & Mobile Software**: Full-stack SaaS platforms, custom web portals, cross-platform iOS & Android mobile apps (React Native/Flutter), and administrative dashboards.
- **High-Converting Websites**: Responsive local business websites, landing pages, E-Commerce stores, and interactive WebGL 3D websites.
- **Technical SEO & Growth**: Technical audits, Schema.org JSON-LD microdata, Core Web Vitals optimization, local SEO, and Google Business Profile optimization.

---

## 2. Rapid Turnaround Schedules
- **Business Websites & Landing Pages**: Delivered in 48 Hours
- **Autonomous AI Voice & WhatsApp Agents**: Deployed in < 3 Business Days
- **Custom Software & SaaS Applications**: Delivered in < 7 Business Days

---

## 3. Technology Stack & Frameworks
- **Frontend & Web**: Next.js 14 (App Router), React 18, TailwindCSS, Vanilla CSS, Three.js / WebGL, Framer Motion, HTML5, JavaScript (ES2024).
- **Backend & Cloud**: Python FastAPI, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM, Redis, Docker, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Vercel Enterprise.
- **AI Models & Integrations**: OpenAI GPT-4o & O3, Anthropic Claude 3.5, ElevenLabs Conversational Voice API, Twilio Telephony, Meta WhatsApp Cloud API, LangChain, LlamaIndex, n8n.
- **Payments**: Razorpay Live Gateway (UPI, NetBanking, Credit Cards, Cards), Stripe.
